title: Isaiah 53:7 — like a lamb led to slaughter
summary: Isaiah 53:7 in English and Hebrew: the servant was oppressed and afflicted yet did not open His mouth, like a lamb led to slaughter. 'He/His' is in red, and 'lamb' and its Hebrew שה are in grey.

text.text: 7 He was oppressed and He was afflicted, Yet He did not open His mouth; Like a lamb that is led to slaughter, And like a sheep that is silent before its shearers, So He did not open His mouth.
7 נגש והוא נענה ולא יפתח־פיו כשה לטבח יובל וכרחל לפני גזזיה נאלמה ולא יפתח פיו׃

keywords: as a lamb to the slaughter
